tests.pins: The namespace/nesting-type wrappers emitted around the resolver (ResolverTemplate/CompositeResolverTemplate) and formatters (via IFormatterTemplate) produce compilable code declaring the resolver in its declared namespace (or global) implementing IFormatterResolver with formatters for collected types.

MessagePackGenerator.Generate adds, for each collected enum, an EnumTemplate output that compiles to a <Enum>Formatter implementing IMessagePackFormatter<Enum> and reading the underlying type (ReadByte for a byte enum).

MessagePackGenerator.Generate adds, for each [Union] type, a UnionTemplate output that compiles to an <Type>Formatter implementing IMessagePackFormatter<Type> whose maps reference every declared sub type.
